name: template-definition
body: Each project template lives in `templates/slides/<name>/` (a slide template) or `templates/sections/<name>/` (a section template); its kind is determined by that directory (see templates-dir-layout). It defines: name (its directory name, unique across slides and sections), one-line description, a field/section/body schema (in `template.yaml`, see template-manifest), a Go html/template layout (`layout.html.tmpl`, see template-language), and an example slide (`example.md`) that itself validates. Templates are project files owned by the template author; deck authors select them but never define per-slide styling.
